meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides Apple Music's subscription banner and Open in Music nag; toggles for shelves, charts, radio, artwork, the player bar and footer
meta.notes:
**Live check (2026-11-17).** Opened `https://music.apple.com/us/new` logged out in a desktop-UA browser at 1440×900 and read the DOM 9 seconds after load. `recipes/fixtures/apple-music/desktop-live-new.html` is a trimmed reconstruction of its structure (shelves reduced to one of each kind), alongside the earlier `desktop-real.html` excerpt of 2026-11-14.

Seen live and used: `[data-testid="upsell-banner"]` 1, `[data-testid="native-cta"]` 1, `[data-testid="auth-content"]` 1, the Radio navigation item, `[data-testid="section-container"]` (about 20 shelves, each with an English `aria-label`), `editorial-card-wrapper` (Featured hero), `vertical-video`, the `grid` under More to Explore, `artwork-component`, `track-lockup-artwork`, `explicit-badge`, `up-next-button`, `chrome-volume`, `player-bar` and `footer`.

**Not verified:** the shelf rules for charts, Trending Songs, radio, tour and DJ mixes match the shelf's English title (`aria-label`), so they do nothing in other languages and stop matching if Apple renames a shelf. Hover play buttons and the album, playlist and artist pages were not checked. Cover-art rules cover the `artwork-component` and lockup wrappers; whether every card image sits inside one was not confirmed. Signed-in views, the mobile layout and the cookie dialog (none appeared) were not available. The previous generic cookie, ad and app-banner rules matched nothing live and were not carried over.

- The subscription banner and Open in Music button are on by default.
- Everything else is off by default: Sign In, Radio tab, shelf and chart rows, hero, artwork, Explicit badges, Up Next, volume and footer.
